A '''bodyguard''' was employed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Bezz Drexx]] sometime during the span of an [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] event known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] was the only known member of Drexx's security force that was not a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]]. The guard worked on the upper levels of [[Bezz Drexx's tower]], located on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and carried a [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]] as his primary weapon of defense. During a party event being hosted by Drexx, the senator from the planet of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], along with an aide named [[Sheltay Retrac/Legends|Sheltay Retrac]], [[Infiltration of Bezz Drexx's tower|infiltrated]] the upper levels of the tower to expose Drexx for his dealings with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After gathering the evidence they needed, they attempted to escape, but Amidala was cornered by the brute guard. After giving her a shock with his lightwhip, she stunned him with a device of her own, which allowed her enough time to escape. After recovering, the guard gave chase, only for Amidala to evade capture by jumping off of a balcony.
